d.d: Concerned with orogeny; pertaining to the creation of mountains.
The process of mountain building by the upward folding of the Earth's crust.
A member of a people of eastern Africa, Ethiopia and northern Kenya.
The Cushitic language of this people.
Of or pertaining to both the mouth and the pharynx.
Of or pertaining to the oropharynx.
Ellipsis of oropharyngeal airway (“an adjunct device used to open and secure a patient's airway during emergencies”).
